01 / The Descent

Built for momentum.
Forged for pressure.

Spright is a fast, atmospheric action-platformer where movement is survival and every room asks you to commit.

Dash through sealed ruins, break enemy patterns, hunt blueprints, and push deeper into a world that keeps changing the rules.
